dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL with htmlpp preprocessor extension; part of a Brazilian web-based SIV (Sistema de Informações de Vendas) / GDD panel application using EXEC HTML syntax and OOP-style class repository (EscreveJson, Utils). Likely compiled with GnuCOBOL + a custom HTML preprocessor.

purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian SIV (Sistema de Informações de Vendas) - GDD (Grupo de Distribuição/Dados) panel management screen; appears to be a retail/distribution management web UI panel
purpose.summary: This program renders an HTML panel for the 'Novo SIV - Painel GDD' system, allowing users to select a GDD and a Quadro (board/panel), then consult and manage Grupo de Produtos (product groups). It validates a project flag (177-GVP Rs e Extratos) before proceeding and delegates processing via a dynamic CALL to a return function.

notable_features: EXEC HTML ... END-EXEC custom preprocessor blocks
No PIC clauses in main source (all in copybooks)
HTML/JavaScript embedded directly in COBOL via htmlpp preprocessor
verdict.notes: Source uses a custom htmlpp preprocessor that embeds HTML/JS inside EXEC HTML blocks, which is non-standard COBOL. The mechanical indicator shows source_format_guess=fixed but the $set sourceformat"free" directive and long lines confirm free format. The domain is classified as 'other' because it is a Brazilian distribution/sales information system that does not map cleanly to standard domains. Program type mapped to online-cics as the closest analog for an interactive web/CGI program.
